text_en: His son Jehoshaphat succeeded him, and strengthened himself against Israel.
text_cn: 阿撒的儿子约沙法特继位为王， 发奋图强，对抗以色列，

text_en: He placed forces in all the fortified cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah, and in the cities of Ephraim that his father Asa had taken.
text_cn: 在犹大各坚城内派驻了大军，在犹大地内和他父亲阿撒所克服的厄弗辣因各城里，也派上了守军。

text_en: The Lord was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the earlier ways of his father; he did not seek the Baals,
text_cn: 上主与约沙法特同在，因为他遵行了他父亲最初所行的道路，没有寻求过巴耳神，

text_en: but sought the God of his father and walked in his commandments, and not according to the ways of Israel.
text_cn: 只寻求他父亲的天主，履行他的诫命，不照以色列的作风行事。

text_en: Therefore the Lord established the kingdom in his hand. All Judah brought tribute to Jehoshaphat, and he had great riches and honor.
text_cn: 因此，上主巩固了他统治的王国，全犹大人都给约沙法特献礼，所以他财产很富，尊荣很大。

text_en: His heart was courageous in the ways of the Lord ; and furthermore he removed the high places and the sacred poles from Judah.
text_cn: 他一心在上主的道路上向上迈进，铲除了犹大境内的高丘和木偶。

text_en: In the third year of his reign he sent his officials, Ben-hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel, and Micaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah.
text_cn: 他为王第三年上，派遣了他的官员本海耳、敖巴狄雅、则加黎雅、乃塔乃耳和米加雅，往犹大各城去教训百姓。

text_en: With them were the Levites, Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tob-adonijah; and with these Levites, the priests Elishama and Jehoram.
text_cn: 随从他们的有肋未人舍玛雅、乃塔尼雅、则巴狄雅、阿撒耳、舍米辣摩特、约纳堂、阿多尼雅和多彼雅：这些都是肋未人；还有司祭厄里沙玛和约兰。

text_en: They taught in Judah, having the book of the law of the Lord with them; they went around through all the cities of Judah and taught among the people.
text_cn: 他们随身带着上主的法律书，在犹大施教，走遍了犹大各城，教训百姓。

text_en: The fear of the Lord fell on all the kingdoms of the lands around Judah, and they did not make war against Jehoshaphat.
text_cn: 上主威震犹大四周所有的国家，因此都不敢与约沙法特作战。

text_en: Some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents, and silver for tribute; and the Arabs also brought him seven thousand seven hundred rams and seven thousand seven hundred male goats.
text_cn: 有些培肋舍特人向约沙法特进贡献银，阿剌伯人给他呈献家畜，即公绵羊七千七百只，公山羊七千七百只。

text_en: Jehoshaphat grew steadily greater. He built fortresses and storage cities in Judah.
text_cn: 约沙法特的势力日渐强大，达到顶峰：在犹大建造了一些堡垒和贮货城，

text_en: He carried out great works in the cities of Judah. He had soldiers, mighty warriors, in Jerusalem.
text_cn: 在犹大各城又做了坚固的工事，在耶路撒冷驻有英勇的部队。

text_en: This was the muster of them by ancestral houses: Of Judah, the commanders of the thousands: Adnah the commander, with three hundred thousand mighty warriors,
text_cn: 他们的人数，按照家族记录如下：犹大的军长，首为阿德纳军长，率领三十万勇士，

text_en: and next to him Jehohanan the commander, with two hundred eighty thousand,
text_cn: 次为约哈南军长，率领二十八万人，

text_en: and next to him Amasiah son of Zichri, a volunteer for the service of the Lord , with two hundred thousand mighty warriors.
text_cn: 其次为齐革黎的儿子阿玛息雅，他甘愿献身于上主，率领二十万勇士；

text_en: Of Benjamin: Eliada, a mighty warrior, with two hundred thousand armed with bow and shield,
text_cn: 属本雅明的有勇士厄肋雅达，他率领二十万挽弓和持盾的人；

text_en: and next to him Jehozabad with one hundred eighty thousand armed for war.
text_cn: 其次为约匝巴得，率领十八万常备军人。

text_en: These were in the service of the king, besides those whom the king had placed in the fortified cities throughout all Judah.
text_cn: 这些都是服侍君王的人，王在全犹大各坚城所派驻的人，尚未计算在内。
